exemplars.title: VITALITY: Promoting Serendipitous Discovery of Academic Literature with Transformers & Visual Analytics
exemplars.why: VITALITY is the cleanest structural match: an interactive visualization canvas directly renders a two-dimensional UMAP projection of literature embeddings, making the computed spatial arrangement an explicit exploratory surface for discovery.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above MAICO because the evidence explicitly identifies both a 2-D projection algorithm and an interactive canvas, whereas MAICO establishes exploration of a similarity layout but does not explicitly confirm dimensionality or canvas interaction.

exemplars.title: MAICO: A Visualization Design Study on AI-Assisted Music Composition
exemplars.why: MAICO shows the collection-level mechanism unusually well: every music sample appears simultaneously as a dot in a similarity-based space, and the user explores that space to obtain an overview rather than navigating a list of samples.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above Anthology because its evidence explicitly describes the user exploring the computed space, while Anthology establishes a semantic landscape but not navigation through it.

exemplars.title: Anthology: AI-Augmented Sensemaking Interface to Reduce Radicalization in Conversations
exemplars.why: Anthology places all topical utterances into one semantic landscape where proximity has an explicit meaning— thematic similarity—and overlays shapes and colors to expose narrative clusters, making neighborhoods directly useful for inspecting a complex conversation.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above PromptMagician because the evidence confirms complete collection coverage and defines the meaning of proximity, whereas PromptMagician explains semantic placement but does not establish that the whole collection or map is the primary navigation surface.

notes: I departed from the consensus by promoting MAICO from fourth to second and excluding second-ranked PromptMagician. MAICO more directly supports the structural signature by showing all units simultaneously in a similarity-based space that the user explicitly explores; PromptMagician strongly documents semantic positioning but does not establish collection coverage, a 2-D canvas, or map-centered navigation. The score adjustments are modest and none exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust any inference that these excerpts prove the full interaction contract: none explicitly verifies panning/zooming or that queries and selections re-highlight or re-weight the map instead of returning a separate result view. VITALITY and Anthology also rely on brief figure evidence rather than a detailed interaction account.
